skill.summary: AI Agent 团队 - 61 个专业 Agent，8 大部门，完整的 AI 代理机构。支持单 Agent 使用和多 Agent 协作编排。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of automate-nbm (v1.0.0):

- Introduces a comprehensive AI Agent team skill featuring 61 specialized agents across 8 departments.
- Supports single agent use, department-level collaboration, and multi-agent orchestrated workflows.
- Provides clear command examples, output formats, and configuration options for flexible enterprise automation.
- Includes detailed agent and department descriptions, workflow diagrams, troubleshooting guidance, and best practices.
